explanation: Run used standard CLAS12 eta settings: EtaMAID model 3, full O(alpha) mode, 6.53 GeV electron beam, recoil-proton detection, and vcut=0.166 GeV^2. EXCLURAD wrote sigma_Born as 0.0008651649 in radtot.dat. It wrote NaN for the radiative correction delta (sigar(1)/sibar(1)) because the full tail integration produced NaN contributions; delta is therefore null.
